CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(MargenOperacion__c), IF( TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey) = "en_US", "No items", "Sin items" ), IF( Aprobado_Direccion__c, IF( TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey) = "en_US", "Approved", "Aprobada" ), IF( OR( MargenOperacion__c < 0.18, (Cuenta__r.Parent.Balance_Cuenta__c - ImporteTotal__c) < 0 ), IF( TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey) = "en_US", "Requires Approval", "Requiere Aprobación" ), IF( TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey) = "en_US", "Meets Conditions", "Cumple Condiciones" ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Estado Operación
